name: Tear Clean
memo: Red Hot Chili Peppers - Tear: verses and intro. Clean Strat-style tone with Boss CE-1 style chorus and a touch of room reverb.

band.style_feel: slow ballad, half-time backbeat with soft snare on 3, sparse hi-hat, bass holding long notes
band.key: C major (C - G - Am - F, with Em and Dm in the chorus)
parts: Part A: intro and verse - quiet, sparse drums
Part C: solo - full band, driving
Part D: final verse and chorus - full band, then fade
band.tips: Tempo sources disagree: about 66 BPM felt in half-time (131 BPM if counted in doubles). Verify against the recording by tapping. Play the intro 2 bars cleanly before the Trio+ starts learning and keep strumming steady.

whammy.tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
how: Tune your guitar to standard (E A D G B E).
whammy.tips: Chord sheets for this song use standard tuning and no whammy or octave effect is documented, so none is set.

originals.guitar: Fender Stratocaster (1962 and 1954 models were his main guitars of the era)

guitar.position: neck or neck+middle pickup for the clean verse; bridge pickup for the chorus and solo, tone around 7
guitar.tone_notes: Glassy single-coil clean with chorus. A humbucker guitar will sound thicker: use the neck pickup and raise treble a little.

name: Tear Chorus
memo: Red Hot Chili Peppers - Tear: chorus and solo. Marshall-style crunch with a fuzz/distortion boost, Frusciante style.
